description_paragraphs: This course further guides students through the end-to-end lifecycle of building data-driven solutions - from setting up environments to packaging final deliverables for real-world use.
faculty: Mr. Anand S, CEO, Gramener (now part of Straive)

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Setup - Setting up development environments, managing dependencies, and configuring tools required to build reliable data workflows and applications.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Deploy - Deploying models and applications to production environments, ensuring scalability, accessibility, and smooth integration with real-world systems.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Source - Identifying and collecting relevant data from diverse sources such as APIs, web scraping, databases, and external repositories.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Wrangle - Cleaning, transforming, and structuring raw data into usable formats, handling missing values, inconsistencies, and data quality issues.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Analyse - Applying statistical and computational techniques to extract meaningful patterns, trends, and insights from data.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Test - Validating models, pipelines, and outputs through systematic testing to ensure correctness, robustness, and reliability.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Present - Communicating insights effectively using narratives, dashboards, and visualizations tailored to different stakeholders.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Package - Packaging models, code, and workflows into reusable, maintainable, and deployable units for production and collaboration.
